senses.gloss: to paint the face with rouge (cmp. φυκόω).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 10:6">Sabb. X, 6</cite> <he>וכן הפּוֹקֶסֶת</he> and the same is the case with her who rouges (on the Sabbath); Y. ib. X, end, 12ᵈ <he>הפוקסת חייבת משום צובעה</he> rouging comes under the category of dyeing. Bab. ib. 64ᵇ <he>שלא תכחול ולא תִפְקוֹס</he> that she (the menstruant) must not paint (her eyes) nor rouge.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 20b:13">M. Kat. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>אינו רשאי לכוף … ולהיות פוקסת</he> dare not force his wife (mourning for a parent) to paint or rouge; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to make small curls pasted on the forehead.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 94b:11">Sabb. 94ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 10:6">Sabb. X, 6</cite>) <he>פוקסת משום טווה</he> curling comes under the category of spinning; ib. 95ᵃ <he>גודלת ופוקסת משום בונה</he> plaiting the hair and curling comes under the category of building.

senses.gloss: to remove the coils of blossoms on gourds.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 1:5">Maasr. I, 5</cite> <he>משיִפָּקְסוּ ואם אינו מְפקֵּס וכ׳</he> are subject to tithes when they are trimmed, and if one does not want to trim &c.; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 88b:3">B. Mets. 88ᵇ</cite>, expl. <he>משינטל פיקס שלהן</he>, v. <cite ref="Q00815"><he>פֶּיקָס</he></cite>. Y. Maasr. I, 49ᵃ <he>היה מפקס ראשון וכ׳</he> (not <he>הוה</he>) if one trims one by one (just when he needs them) and boils &c.; <he>עד שיְפַקֵּס כל צורכו</he> until he has trimmed as many as he wants for immediate use; <cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 1:5">Tosef. ib. I, 5</cite> <he>היה מְפַקֵּיץ ראשין וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. Var.

<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 1:6">Ib. 6</cite> <he>תורמין … אע״פ שלא פִּיקֵּץ</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <cite ref="Q01496"><he>פקס</he></cite>) one must give T’rumah of gourds, even if one did not trim them. Y.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 1:6">ib.</cite> l. c. <he>פיקס ושילק וכ׳</he> if he trimmed and boiled &c.; a. e.
